description: Defines an abstract class 'Area' and a concrete implementation 'Rectangle' for rendering areas in PDF documents, including methods for boundary management, union, and fitting rectangles.

classes.name: Area
classes.description: Abstract base class for all renderable areas, providing properties and methods for boundary management, union, and lowering.

classes.name: Rectangle
classes.description: Concrete implementation of 'Area' representing rectangular regions with methods for fitting, union, and lowering.

methods.name: GetFittingRect
methods.description: Returns the largest rectangle fitting within the area at a specified y position and height.

methods.name: Unite
methods.description: Returns the union of this area with another area.

methods.name: Lower
methods.description: Lowers the area by a specified vertical offset.
